text: We’re about to renew my A5 visa in TLV for the last time and should be able to apply for permanent residency next summer (we’re a same-sex couple, so have to apply for PR first). Do we also need to apply 3 months before my last A5 is going to expire for the permanent residency ? Is it the same process like when you apply for citizenship (providing the special docs, extra interview, etc.) ? Right after PR, we’d like to apply for citizenship.
